title: Surrounded Regions
prompt: Given an m x n matrix board containing 'X' and 'O', capture all regions that are 4-directionally surrounded by 'X'. A region is captured by flipping all 'O's into 'X's in that surrounded region.

examples.output: All O's not on border get flipped

hints: Reverse thinking: O's on the border and connected to border cannot be captured. DFS from all border O's, mark them (e.g. 'T').
Then: all remaining 'O' are surrounded - flip to 'X'. Flip 'T' back to 'O'.
Or use union-find: connect border O to a dummy node. O's not connected to dummy get flipped.
